newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Santander rates Mexico retail firms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Santander rates Mexico retail firms.

text.p: --Santander rated four Mexican commercial and retail firms.
--Organizacion Soriana started with buy, Grupo Gigante started with underperform, Cifra upgraded to buy from market perform and Controladora Comercial Mexicana (Comerci) reiterated at buy.
--Santander analyst Rolando Calderon says "Mexican economy recovering faster than expected" and "retail sector should see a significant recovery in 1997."
--Says retailers increasing floor space which "should fuel overall annual sales expansion in excess of 10 percent."
--Cifra remains the undisputed leader in the industry, but Santander favors Comerci and Soriana.
--Cifra premium seen diminishing but upside potential forecast at at 25.1 percennt in dollar terms.
--"Comerci trades at an unjustified discount to its peers," Calderon says.
--Gigante is the second most expensive retailer, but "We believe that this premium is not justified, given its recent week results."
--Soriana given a buy rating because it most profitable retailer and second-cheapest stock in this four-company sample.
